{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = sales[(sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (sales['status'] == 'completed')]

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] = loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Count QA orders
n_qa_orders = len(qa_orders)
print("Number of QA orders in LOYAL completed orders:", n_qa_orders)

# Remove QA orders
loyal_completed_clean = loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Compute mean revenue on cleaned data
mean_revenue = loyal_completed_clean['revenue_clean'].mean()
print("Mean revenue of LOYAL completed orders (after removing QA orders):", mean_revenue)"}
